name: Audio DSP Denormal Float Flushing (DAZ/FTZ)
description: Flushes IEEE-754 denormal (subnormal) floating-point numbers to zero to prevent 100x CPU microcode slowdowns during decay states or low-magnitude neural activations.
recommendations: Configure DAZ (Denormals-Are-Zero) and FTZ (Flush-To-Zero) hardware flags on real-time inference worker threads.
Clamp decaying weights and floating point state updates below EPSILON (1e-12) to true zero.
Verify numeric convergence loops never enter denormal execution states that trigger CPU microcode traps.
